method: Built-in image_gen, one transparent spritesheet per chapter; source PNGs copied unchanged.

assets.boss: a larger muscular dire wolf with curling ivy antlers and a torn red hunting sash
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual production enemy animation spritesheet for a 2D portrait mobile fairy-tale idle RPG, RogueTales. Create ONE transparent square 2048x2048 PNG laid out as EXACTLY FOUR columns by FOUR rows, sixteen equal square cells, no visible grid lines, no labels. Every character faces LEFT toward the heroes, full body visible inside its own cell, same camera, same body size and feet baseline within each row. The bottom of the feet is at 90 percent of cell height; bodies centered near 50 percent of cell width. Leave at least 10 percent transparent padding on every side of each cell. NO artwork may cross into another cell. Four animation poses per row are consecutive frames of one loop/action, not four different designs. Row 1: regular enemy idle frames 1-4, subtle breathing, blink, return to pose 1. Row 2: SAME regular enemy attack frames 1-4: ready, windup, LEFT-facing strike, recovery. Row 3: boss enemy idle frames 1-4, subtle breathe, blink, return. Row 4: SAME boss attack frames 1-4: ready, windup, LEFT-facing strike, recovery. Preserve the exact design, face, clothing, palette and body proportions between frames for each enemy. Style: polished hand-drawn 2D fairy-tale RPG cartoon, bold clean outlines, expressive chibi proportions, rich flat colors and subtle cel shading, crisp silhouettes, appealing menacing monsters, original art, not pixel art, no photorealism, no 3D render. All backgrounds genuinely transparent alpha, including between cells. No floor, no scenery, no shadows on a ground plane, no typography, no borders, no extra decorative objects, no watermarks. Clear correctly separated sprites, no portraits. Chapter theme: enchanted woodland. Regular enemy design: a sly charcoal wolf with emerald moss tufts and glowing amber eyes. Boss design: a larger muscular dire wolf with curling ivy antlers and a torn red hunting sash. Shared palette: charcoal, moss emerald, warm amber.
